[u][b][size=3]DO NOT install this with the other [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31511]"Friendable Mr.Qi"[/url]﻿ mod - they are literally the same thing except this one has WAY less content. They are separated for easier matienence/figuring out what has issues.
[/size][/b][/u][b][This mod will also not recieve any content adding updates aside from maybe new events if I add those...][/b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16724][size=1]
[/size][/url]
Ever since I started playing Stardew Valley in 2018, and discovered Mr.Qi, I've wanted him to be an NPC. He's genuinely my favorite character in the game despite the minimal content. And since I started modding in 2022 I realized that I could, in fact, make that dream a reality. And so I did! Now you too can actually interact with the blue man![url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16724][size=1]

[/size][/url][i][b]When reporting bugs PLEASE include a [url=http://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]﻿ and a description of what's wrong. Just saying "it's not working" isn't going to help me fix it!
[/b][/i]﻿[/center][/i] [left][img]https://i.imgur.com/Wxu8uY6.png[/img][/left]What it adds:
[list]
[*]One (1) Mr.Qi NPC (that you can marry!)
[*]27 Heart Events - Plus 1 Heart Event with SVE, and one with a certain skull cavern mod - as well as alernate versions for 6 heart events and up if you're in a relationship with him
[*]4 Repeatable dates if you marry him
[*]Responses/reactions to player death if you're married
[*]Custom children sprites (and an option for some RAD children)
[*]Over 1000+ Dialogue Lines (In part thanks to [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/jazzybees?gameId=1303]Jazzybee[/url]﻿ <3) (I honestly don't even know how many he has now)
[*]2 New Cooking Recipes
[*]A 'new' item to purchase
[*]4 New Quests
[*]3 New Locations
[*]Extensive Configuration Options
[/list]What it does not add/do:[list]
[*]Make Mr.Qi a redeemable person
[*]Add the cure for depression
[/list]
[b]Side Note: I mention this later but Qi will spawn the day AFTER you go into the Casino for the first time!
[/b]

[b]12 Heart Event - Town:[/b] Between 5pm and 11pm in Winter
[b]13 Heart Event - Town Museum: [/b]Between 3pm and 7pm, must have seen his 11 heart event in the saloon
[b]14 Heart Event PT1 - Farm:[/b] Between 6pm and 9pm on a Wednesday

[b]Beach Date:[/b] Weather must be Sunny

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/url]﻿ All Festivals were tested to make sure they had compatibility with SVE locations and NPCs. [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34261]Ohodavi's Portraits for Ms. Qi[/url]: Starlight has created beautiful alternative portraits for this mod for Ms.Qi!

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia:[/url] Nomori oh so graciously added compatibility for their lovely witch! Now Qi can have magic beef with her too! 

[size=3][u][b]Incompatible:
[/b][/u][/size][b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15100]Seven Deadly Sins:[/url][/b] Initially I was going to incorporate compatibility with this mod in 1.1.0, however it's going to be a larger, and harder task than I initially thought. This is not a priority, but if someone would like to assist with it I am more than willing to accept help, as it will take a while otherwise.
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12422]
Mr.Qi Dialogue Expansion:[/url]﻿ Not compatible as the default Qi Npc Is rendered invisible and moved, however I got permission from Jaz to include as much of the dialogue within my mod as I want as well as to use it as inspiration - so the mod is essentially built in (thank you Jaz! <3) 

[b]Qi Portraits:[/b] NOT compatible with many that presently exist, this mod adds 13 new portrait expressions for Mr.Qi (as well as two that aren't him but are used for something else) and therefore other portraits will not work. If you have portrait mods that change him you will have to disable them.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4310]Mx.Qi:[/url]﻿ Due to some of the config options I have for my mod, you get to choose what honorific Qi goes by. As such, my mod edits all references to Mr. Qi to follow whatever you select it to be. This means it probably edits the stuff that this mod edits - so it will not be compatible nor will you need it - my mod [i]also[/i] edits those areas to make sure he does not call you 'kid' if you choose to switch that too. 

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25567]Craftable Qi Seasoning:[/url]﻿ This is a mod that I made that is now integrated within Friendable Mr.Qi - do not install both, you dont need them and i have no clue what that would do or if it would break anything. This also applies for any other mods that add a recipe for the seasoning.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16724]Mister Qi Is A Real NPC:[/url] Honestly I have no clue if this is compatible, I don't know how they edit Mr.Qi or turn him into an NPC, but the likilhood is that it's not, so don't install them both.﻿

[b]Any mod that adds Craftable Auto-Petters: [/b]Technically they might work if they name the recipe something else, but for the most part avoid those as well.

[b]Misc: [/b]Any other mods that edit the right side of the casino
Any mod that edits the Walnut Room... I couldn't find one but if it does it won't work with mine. I can add compatibility if they're brought to my attention :)

Recolor mods will technically work but I have some custom tilesheets so a fair few thing will look weird, it is possible for mod authors to target these assets to recolor them as well for recolor compatibility, but I do NOT have the time or patience for that B')

[i]Other than that it should not conflict with anything else but if you find anything let me know :)[/i]
[/spoiler]

[b]Configs: I HIGHLY suggest using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to edit these[/b]
[spoiler][u][size=3]Qi Edits Section:[/size][/u]
[b]Include Perfection Friendship: [/b]True/False - Toggles whether or not Friendship with Qi counts towards perfection
[b]Qi Farmer Reference:[/b] Kid/Farmer/@ (looks like an arrow, this just means your name) - Changes what Qi refers to you as in his dialogue
[b]Qi Gender:[/b] Male/Female/Undefined/Random - Changes the internal gender of Qi,the honorific Qi uses (Mr. Mx. Ms.), how you have children with them, their sprites/portraits, and a variety of other things
[b]Qi Farmer Endearment Reference:[/b] What endearment term Qi uses for you when you're dating/married  - default is 'My Star'
[b]Qi Child Adoption:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the farmer and Qi can have children or only adopt them
[b]Qi Child Question:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not Qi will ask for children/wants children
[b]Qi Children Sprites:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the children will use custom sprites to look like Qi (They're blue)
[b]Radical Qi Children:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not the children you have with Qi will have sunglasses (RADICAL!)
[b]Qi Date Chance:[/b] [0-100] - Sets the chance for one of the repeatable dates with Qi to happen
[b]Simple Qi Schedule:[/b] True/False - Switches between Qi's default, more complex schedule, and a simpler one
[b]Nyapu Style Qi Portraits:[/b] True/False - Toggles Nyapu style Qi portraits
[b]Easy Quests:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not you want Qi's mailed quests to be easier or not

[u][size=3]Other Section:[/size][/u]
[b]Sparkly Qi Hat:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether or not Qi's hat the player can get in game (and put on their pet) has sparkles.
[b]Winter Qi Hat:[/b] True/False - Toggles whether Qi's hat the player can get in game has regular sparkles or is the winter variant (does nothing if the previous option is not enabled.)
[b]SVE Qi Silencing Event:[/b] True/False - Toggles the silencing event from SVE to be edited/patched. Does nothing without SVE.
[/spoiler]

[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Optionally: Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore﻿[/url]﻿
[*]Download and Extract this mod to your Mods folder
[*]Have fun!
[/list][b]> Qi will spawn in the day after you enter the Casino! (This was to make sure he didn't start wandering around the Valley before you met him)

[/b][img]https://i.imgur.com/gXY3N0N.png[/img]
[b][u]Known Bugs + Bug Reporting:[/u][/b][list]
[*]On the first day of unlocking the Casino, if you try to click on his door it'll spam red into your SMAPI Console. This is technically because he doesn't exist yet, and will go away on day 2 (I could not, for the life of me, fix this)
[*]Qi will still kill you if you cheat onto the Summit while married or dating... I can't fix this, and even if I could I wouldn't because it's kinda funny and also, don't cheat
[*]Qi's dialogue in other mods will be funky fresh and will not match up.
[*]Without Spacecore there is a high likelihood that NPCs will do weird pathing into Qi's room and get stuck there. I cannot fix this, it's just the way that Stardew is. Very weird, not cool.
[/list]
[i][b]Again, when reporting bugs PLEASE include a SMAPI log and a description of what's wrong. Just saying "it's not working" isn't going to help me fix it! There is no feasible way I can test everything in this mod or every dialogue line so I'm sure some of it's broken, I'll fix it ASAP when bugs are noticed.
[/b][/i]
